environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The Split.io proxy sidecar container is not deployed (cost optimization). FLAG_SERVICE_URL points to a non-routable internal address (http://10.0.99.99:8081). The get_feature_flag function times out after 2s and returns the default value (False), meaning CSRF enforcement is never active. SameSite cookie attribute is not set on session cookies (uvicorn default). No Origin/Referer header validation.
